you can copy anything in this mod
if you find or fix any problems please tell me
fyi: on some game updates the ui folder is reset and you have to install again (so keep a backup if you make any edits)
fyi: you will have to manually insert any new badges (or anything else) the devs add (including ranked badges) to the badge folder yourself to see their icons in game

HOW TO INSTALL:

make a backup of your forts ui folder found in (forts directory)/data if you wish (correct files can always be restored by verifying game files too)
delete the "textures" folder inside your current ui folder from the path <forts directory>/data/ui/textures
delete the file "hud.lua" from the path <forts directory>/data/ui/screens/hud.lua
subscribe to this mod and wait for steam to download it
figure out where this mod is stored on your computer... it should be stored on a path looking something like this D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\410900\3750502564 (depending on what drive it is stored on)
paste the textures folder found in this mod into your forts ui folder
paste the hud.lua file from this mod into your forts screens folder
open the game and go to options -> game -> HUD Skin and change it to "Default"
should work
i encourage you to customize the hud yourself to fit it to your own needs (ui/screens/hud.lua and ui/textures/ will be most useful for this)
also check out this mod if you are interested in that: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2991656794
